decision: Retain all32 checks: no evidence supports deleting distinct behavior coverage. Separate setup from acceptance and limit each to representative source-backed observations.

checks.expectation: Fresh reset reaches title input with visible title artwork/options, two title actors, normal option marker and title music after source fades.
checks.scope: One reset-to-title with source fades and representative image/music evidence; no exhaustive title animation phases.

checks.expectation: Right/Select and Left wrap the three EASY/NORMAL/DIFFICULT markers; held input does not repeat; menu-change sound is authored.
checks.scope: Exercise both wrap directions, Select and held-no-repeat once; no Cartesian product of options and frame timings.

checks.expectation: Start enters the five-land screen through fade/upload; Up/Down wraps cursor and name, A confirms selected original land.
checks.scope: One five-land wrap cycle and one confirmation; later entries own their level content checks.

checks.expectation: Amazon entry completes initialization/fade with source player/camera position, terrain, timer/health, actors and stage song.
checks.scope: One validated initial Amazon state and representative presentation/audio; reuse as setup rather than restart for every check.

checks.expectation: Walking changes world position; A initiates jump, gravity changes vertical motion, floor landing restores standing without passing solid terrain.
checks.scope: Representative walk, full jump/landing and solid boundary; unusual collision branches belong to targeted regressions when justified.

checks.expectation: Airborne held Down+B produces the source pogo landing/rebound; after blocked walking reaches animation07, a newly pressed B enters cane swing with the source impact animation/sound and overlap result.
checks.scope: One pogo rebound and valid contextual swing/impact. Establish pose first; do not guess arbitrary B timing.

checks.expectation: Actual contextual strikes mutate source terrain and execute negative-counter recovery creation with matching allocation/cull semantics; a separate natural contact-health reward executes its full delay/reveal/recovery/collection chain, improves actual health and matches source audio dispatch, priority suppression and emitted effects. Culled terrain food is never counted collected.
checks.scope: Retain proven terrain mutation/birth/cull and separate health-collection cases. Preserve priority regression evidence, but do not re-derive routes or require every driver byte in unrelated setups.

checks.expectation: Ordinary enemies initialize/move/attack; unprotected contact removes health and starts recoil/protection with deliberate visible flashing; protection prevents repeated damage.
checks.scope: Representative ordinary contact/recoil/protection/flash cycle; add source-distinct uncovered behaviors, not every enemy placement.

checks.expectation: Start toggles source status streams; ordinary player/actor/timer progression pauses while interrupts/audio continue; next Start resumes.
checks.scope: One open/pause/resume cycle with progression frozen and interrupt/audio continuing; no indefinite panel waiting.

checks.expectation: Aligned Up/Down climbs source surfaces, crossing a room threshold performs the 60-step vertical transition and rejoins gameplay with correct row/cache/actors.
checks.scope: Retain source-required climb amounts and sixty transition phases; validated climbing-entry cache is the setup.

checks.expectation: A source boundary performs horizontal background/player motion, restores stage/row and enters late-stage mode with boundary music/palette.
checks.scope: Any source-legitimate horizontal boundary satisfying CheckStageBoundary/CheckStageBoundaryX/EnterLateStageHorizontalTransition. Moon key/dialogue/health/death routes are prerequisites, not K success criteria. Inspect transition tables for a cheaper legitimate approach before more Moon route discovery; preserve all existing artifacts.

checks.expectation: Source NPC contact opens paced text/panel, acknowledged choices follow the source accept/reject/payment branch, then restore gameplay and status.
checks.scope: One paced dialogue with source-distinct accept/reject/payment outcomes where applicable; cache valid contact setup and avoid repeating travel.

checks.expectation: A source rideable/moving platform carries the player through collision-aware movement and releases via its source jump/exit condition.
checks.scope: One representative carry and legal release, extending only for distinct documented platform behavior; no exhaustive relative positions.

checks.expectation: Source-triggered special room loads its own layout/spawns/CHR without changing original stage identity; its exit returns through the source selection/reload path.
checks.scope: One legitimate special-room entry and return, checking identity/content; do not bypass the entry being tested.

checks.expectation: Amazon handler2E attacks/shakes, respects hit protection, loses five shared HP through legal attacks and produces collectable stage treasure with source effects.
checks.scope: Distinct Amazon boss phases/protection, legal defeat and treasure; reuse valid approach, not the whole level route.

checks.expectation: Treasure sets Amazon progress, converts remaining timer with source cadence/sounds, returns to selection, transfers displayed value and skips completed Amazon.
checks.scope: One actual treasure-to-selection/score-transfer/completed-land flow; do not restore past the transition under test.

checks.expectation: Transylvania room progression reaches handler26, its preset/fire phases produce projectiles; legal hits produce treasure and complete its progress bit.
checks.scope: Retain Transylvania distinct fire/projectile mechanics and defeat; shared setup infrastructure does not merge distinct boss behavior.

checks.expectation: African Mines source prerequisite/contact/room route reaches handler28; perimeter encounter can be defeated and its treasure updates the source progress bit.
checks.scope: Validate prerequisite provenance and one distinct encounter/defeat; retain valid gate approach instead of recollecting prerequisites each run.

checks.expectation: Himalayas source NPC/hit/escort progression changes its terrain condition; handler2A waves/children and legal defeat lead to collected treasure.
checks.scope: Cover escort terrain effect and distinct boss waves/defeat as bounded subcases; avoid replaying escort setup for each boss assertion.

checks.expectation: Moon source prerequisite/route reaches handler29; center attack/random phase, defeat and treasure operate with original progression effects.
checks.scope: Cover Moon prerequisite effect and distinct boss attack/defeat; random possibilities need representative source-backed outcomes, not every RNG seed.

checks.expectation: All five completion bits cause the actual completion message/actor sequence, sixteen deliberate palette flashes and acknowledgment before stage1 late-route initialization.
checks.scope: Actual all-complete transition with deliberate flashes and acknowledgment; restore before trigger with valid prior-completion provenance.

checks.expectation: Late-route final boss teleports/attacks, accepts legal hits under protection rules, then defeat countdown enters final race terrain setup.
checks.scope: Distinct final boss attack/teleport/protection/defeat-to-race flow; representative phases, not every teleport pattern.

checks.expectation: Race setup installs corresponding climbers and goal; rivals progress across rows while the player climbs; reaching goal triggers ending latch through its overlap/delay.
checks.scope: One representative race progression and actual goal overlap/end latch; no requirement to discover a speedrun or prove optimal inputs.

checks.expectation: Post-transfer total last code nonblank and incomplete low7 selects variation0; source scenes, per-eighth-pixel delays and music reach permanent terminal yield.
checks.scope: Retain ending variant0 as a distinct branch; check scene milestones/deliberate timing/terminal state, not every pixel at every frame.

checks.expectation: Source-valid ending with blank final total code selects variation1, executes its scene continuation and reaches terminal state.
checks.scope: Retain ending variant1 with source-valid total provenance; shared ending machinery may reuse assertions, not fabricated results.

checks.expectation: Source-valid low7 progress complete plus nonblank leading total selects variation2 and executes its ending scenes through terminal state.
checks.scope: Retain ending variant2 with valid progress/total provenance; do not remove a distinct ending to reduce runtime.

checks.expectation: At permanent ending wait, Start/A/B do not restart or dispatch ordinary gameplay; interrupts and audio continue.
checks.scope: One validated permanent-ending state and bounded Start/A/B probes; reuse an ending checkpoint rather than replay all variants.

checks.expectation: Fall/damage life loss performs composed waits/fades, decrements life only in reload, restores source checkpoint/health/timer/music and clears temporary controls.
checks.scope: Representative actual life loss/reload with checkpoint/health/timer effects; preserve transition itself and cache earlier approach.

checks.expectation: Countdown decrements via divider, expiration/life depletion reaches game-over presentation, waits240 frames then source reset returns title and clears progression.
checks.scope: Representative expiration and game-over/reset lifecycle; preserve source-defined wait, no brute-force natural countdown for setup if a valid retained state exists.

checks.expectation: EASY alternating health loss and DIFFICULT reward remapping differ from NORMAL exactly as source option consumers specify, without changing menu identities.
checks.scope: Targeted EASY health alternation and DIFFICULT reward branch; no exhaustive difficulty×level×hazard matrix.

checks.expectation: Normal file-manifest startup preserves original land UI; naturally completing Amazon activates its named file successor with actual terrain/graphics/spawn/audio, then restores original content after chain completion.
checks.scope: Authored successor entry/exit under matching asset identity, from a legitimate pre-completion setup; do not repeatedly traverse Amazon merely to rebuild it.

checks.expectation: Same-build replay restores matching semantic/game/output state transactionally; repeated read/render does not alter simulation, sound queues or synthesis clocks.
checks.scope: Bounded checkpoint/replay and repeated observational reads/render at a useful state; not repeated whole-game traversals.

caveat: This is a plan/source-contract review, not new gameplay evidence or a QA pass. Existing scenario assertion precision is changed only with source-backed reasons and record reconciliation.
